_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukino {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe ya ba Mitsindiri.
Ibaro ryawe ni '{symbol}'.
Uzatwara imyitozo ukwiyandikisha ibaro ryawe kweneshuri 5x5 ukora mpatanishi wa 4.
Impatani zishobora kuba mu maji, hejuru, cyangwa ku kiyindi.
Tangaza umwito wawe utumaye ifomati '[4]' ukubeshya gitebo 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uburyo budasobanutse bwo kwimuka. Koresha "[cell]" aho iseri ari 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umubare w'urupapuro udafite agaciro: {cell}. Ugomba kuba uri hagati ya 0 na {max_cell} .

game_action.placed: Umukino {player_id} wunganira ibaro ryawe ({symbol}) mu gitebo ({row}, {col}).

outcome.draw: Umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa!
